output.reason: [ev-216c1792aec9] describes the bug. With dynamic cluster distribution, when the argocd-app-controller-shard-cm exists and there is more than one replica, a restarted app controller pod can end up with shard -1, stop processing applications and leave them stuck refreshing. [ev-fc6423b07d19] describes the fix: the readiness health check now updates the controller's shard number when it has changed and then resyncs all applications. Nothing here says that anything fails, is rejected or needs an operator step after the upgrade. The controller just handles sharding differently, so behavior-change with low severity (review) is supported.
